_doc: The run set: which copy of each edition held more than once the corpus run reads. hadro's
decisions of 2026-10-04, made on results/runset_review.html (the five close calls) and on
results/survey_twins_pairs.json (the rest). The pairs pass RECOMMENDS; this file DECIDES, the
way survey_decisions.json decides the CSV conflicts that apply_survey.py only finds.
`survey_twins.py stamp --write` projects it into the sidecars: each duplicate gets
`survey_status: duplicate-of:<run>` and every member a `run_set` block. `survey_twins.py pairs`
then keeps the decided copy as the run, and hpc/prep_volumes.py refuses to stage a duplicate.
Removing an edition here and re-stamping restores each duplicate's previous status.
`recommended` is what the pairs pass chose where the decision differs from it.
`skip_non_entry_pages`: the stager drops the lines on the volume's `non_entry_pages` leaves.
